QuestInfo.name: Monster Breakup
QuestInfo.0: As White Day comes near, loving monsters are appearing throughout Maple World...
QuestInfo.1: Talk to Cassandra in town to ask about the monsters...of LOVE!
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra explained the loving monsters to you, and you have resolved to hunt them down.

0.0: Oh, I was just thinking about you, #b#h0##k.
0.1: Spring is here, the weather's nice, and soon it will be #bWhite Day#k... Why does everyone care so much about couples, when most of us are single...like me?
0.2: I say we take revenge on all those couplse for making life harder for us singles! What do you think? Wanna hear more?

yes.0: As White Day approaches, #rmonster couples#k have started appearing all around Maple World.
yes.1: The monster couples appear  #bnear Henesys, the Golem's Temple,  Mushroom Castle Wall, the fields of Korean Folk Village, the Wild Bear Areas of Mu Lung, the Minar Forest near Leafre#k and just about everywhere... They're so annoying!
yes.2: Isn't it time we teach those monsters a lesson? When you're ready, come find me in town.

no.0: Hmph! Fine. I see who's side you're on.

1.0: Are you ready to teach these monster couples a lesson? Maybe you'll find #bsomething amazing#k by eliminating these monster couples, so give it a try!
1.1: Oh, but you have to hunt monsters in areas for your level if you want to get something good from them! If you're #bLv. 10-30#k, hunt #rnear Golem's Temple#k; #bLv. 30-50#k, hunt at #rMushroom Castle Wall#k; #bLv. 50-70#k, hunt #rnear the fields of Korean Folk Village#k; #bLv. 70-90#k, hunt at the #rWild Bear Areas#k; and #bLv. 90-110#k, hunt at the #rforests near Leafre#k.
1.2: And if you're level's even higher, don't worry. If you're #bLv. 110-130#k, hunt around the #rKentaurus territories#k in Minar Forest; #bLv. 130-150#k, hunt in Minar Forest's #rcanyon#k; and #bLv. 150+#k, hunt #rnear the Dragon Nest#k.
1.3: Basically, you can get something amazing from the monster couples that are  #b10 levels above or below#k your level. When you meet a monster couple, be sure to check their levels.
1.4: Monster couples are pretty rare, so you'll need to be patient if you want to catch 'em. When you do find a couple, smack them down right away!

yes.0: Up with singles! Down with couples!

default.0: Come see me when you're Lv. 13!
